name: exists_modKernel_integral_bound
summary: The constant c is the one that turns the kernel into a jet of a scaled Taylor series; integrality comes from the standard data module, the conjugate bound from norm_jet_le_of_isAdmissibleComb with the size of the vacuum datum.

steps.claim: (Part of the statement: the statement contains `let … :=`, and the line census of the checker takes that `:=` for the declaration's, so these lines count as the value.) v = c·θ^{I_L, I_N}_{a,b}[Ψ, Q]((1, g), h), and the conclusions (i) and (ii) of the text.
steps.lean:
let v := c * modKernelI (stdSpace D.E L) a b 𝔪 Ψ Q (1, g) h; (∀ p [Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p],
  p.Coprime q → g ∈ integralAbove L p → h ∈ integralAbove N p → Q ∈ (MvPolynomial.map
  embValRing.subtype).range → ‖ιₚ v‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (card L ≤ 40 * D.k → card N ≤ 40 * D.k → d ≤ D.gProd →
  q = 1 → ∀ (σ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ) (M : ℕ) B, (∀ (σ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ) x, ‖σ (Ψ x)‖ ≤ M) → (∀ z, (∀ i, ‖σ (z i)‖ ≤
  D.gProd ^ 4) → ‖σ (Q.eval z)‖ ≤ B) → ‖σ v‖ ≤ exp D.x₁ * M * B) := by

steps.claim: Split the goal: a witness c, the condition c ≠ 0 and the main statement (c is determined by step 10).

For the main statement introduce the characters, 𝔪, q, Ψ and their hypotheses ha, hb, hk (q·g² ∈ 𝔪), hΨ, hQ and v, and rewrite v as an expression to be determined (step 10): a jet of a scaled Taylor series.
steps.lean: swap; introv ha hb hk hΨ hQ v; rw [← (?_ : _ = v)]

steps.claim: Part (i): the jet is p-integral (norm_jet_jetSeries_le_one), because the datum, a power of N times Ψ ⊗ θ°, lies in the standard data module at p (smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData: q·N ∈ 𝔪, Ψ integral away from q, p ∤ q), and the Weil action of points integral above p preserves that module (pairWeil_mem_standardData).
steps.lean:
use fun p _ _ hp hg hh ⟨_, k⟩ ↦ norm_jet_jetSeries_le_one ?_
    (pairWeil_mem_standardData ha hb (smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData hk hΨ hp) hg hh) k

steps.claim: Part (ii): introduce the rank bounds, d ≤ g, q = 1, σ, M, B and the bounds hM, hB; B ≥ 0 (hB at z = 0).
steps.lean: rintro l n hd rfl σ M B hM hB; have := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hB 0 (by simp))

steps.claim: Apply part (i) of norm_jet_le_of_isAdmissibleComb with L = d, w = 0, A = B to the datum Ψ ⊗ θ°, an admissible combination of size |O/𝔪|^{|N×L|}·M (isAdmissibleComb_vacuumDatum, hM). Its hypothesis: on the ball of squared radius e^u(2d + 2)R, |σ(Q(z))| ≤ B·exp(dR), by homogeneity (scale z by e^{−R}) and hB, the entries being at most g⁴ by the scale inequalities (le_of_hasLogBound).
steps.lean:
grw [map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, norm_mul,
    (P.norm_jet_le_of_isAdmissibleComb (isAdmissibleComb_vacuumDatum M
    hM) g h).1 Q d 0 this fun z R e ↦ by simpa [exp_nat_mul, field, mul_comm B, ↓hQ] using (
    comp_aeval_apply (σ.symm (exp R)⁻¹ • X ·) (aeval z) Q ▸ hB _ fun i ↦ le_of_sq_le_sq (by
      simp [field]; grw [(single_le_sum (by simp) (mem_univ i)).trans e, mul_comm]; gcongr
      nlinarith [add_one_le_exp R]; grw [hd]
      simpa [exp_log_eq_abs, bigOmega_pos.ne', ne] using D.le_of_hasLogBound) (by simp) :)]

steps.claim: Bound |O/𝔪| ≤ (q·g²)^{2f} = g^{4f} (Modulus.card_resRing_le with k = q·g², q = 1) and pass to logarithms.
steps.lean: grw [@card_eq_nat_card 𝔪.ResRing, 𝔪.card_resRing_le hk one_le, ← le_exp_of_log_le]

steps.claim: The remaining inequality of logarithms (with |P.c|, d ≤ g and the rank bounds) holds on the scales (le_of_hasLogBound).
steps.lean: simp [ne, log_mul]; norm_cast; grw [le_abs_self P.c, hd, l, n]; use D.le_of_hasLogBound

steps.claim: The deferred identity: v equals the jet of the scaled Taylor series of the integrated datum (homogeneity hQ, pairWeil_integrated_fin); this determines c.
steps.lean: swap; simp [↓hQ, ne, ← pairWeil_integrated_fin, ← mul_assoc]; rfl
